concept.name: Hearth Adaptogenic Sparkling Tonic
concept.description: Sparkling functional beverage with reishi mushroom, ashwagandha, and L-theanine. Designed for "calm focus" without caffeine. $6.50/can, sold in 6-packs. Three flavors: yuzu-ginger, blackberry-sage, grapefruit-rosemary.
